rows.methodology: Real GUI pointer/wheel/click events with CDP dispatch spans and sampled CPU profiles. Input-to-two-rAF is a presentation proxy, not measured physical presentation or INP. Nested trace spans overlap and must not be summed as exclusive CPU time. Profiling and automation add overhead; one controlled desktop run is not a field percentile.

limits: Two captures per strategy on one real project are diagnostic workload observations, not field percentiles or a statistically established regression.
Task totals improve in this capture, but worst-task/frame results do not establish improvement; no overall GUI optimization is shipped.
Other threads run in parallel; their inclusive callback times cannot be added to UI-thread or wall time.

Identical settled pixels in the chosen map region do not establish every asynchronous frame/camera, keyboard-focus, DPR or cancellation/restart outcome. The rejected prototype is not production conformance validation.
Browser/GPU peak memory and worker-load failure recovery are not measured. Installed-tool observations are not cold installation, live-model quality or local large-model validation.
Native preparation wait, generic internal compiler observations, remaining identity/session ownership and full retirement audit remain active.

final_product_profiler.methodology: Real GUI pointer/wheel/click events with document-thread CDP dispatch spans and sampled CPU profiles. Each window records its original process/thread; ambiguous or missing marks fail instead of producing empty measurements. Worker callbacks are excluded from UI-thread stages. Input-to-two-rAF is a presentation proxy, not measured physical presentation or INP. Nested trace spans overlap and must not be summed as exclusive CPU time. Profiling and automation add overhead; one controlled desktop run is not a field percentile.
